description: Reads the Brand Libraries synced to the signed-in one.design account: colours (name and HEX), fonts, logos. Use the colours in other tools (QR codes, watermarks, store shots, bento). save_logos writes the logos to a folder so other tools can use them.

library.description: A library name. Default: all of them.

save_logos.description: Save the logos (and fonts) as files.

name: brand_library
title: Your Brand Libraries
